description: XrmToolBox tool that scaffolds a SQL data-migration harness from Dataverse metadata: staging table and GUID mapping table DDL scripts batched strictly by dependency tier, plus match-key indexes, a styled Excel data dictionary, a machine-readable manifest.json, and a harness metadata seed (meta.Entity / meta.ColumnMap), and generates a tailored SSIS migration harness project from them - including a deferred second pass for every dependency cycle it breaks. Filters tables and columns by solution, remembers selections per environment, and is fully configurable (prefixes, match-key suffixes, dependency-ranking exclusions).
releaseNotes:
1.2026.10.6: Integrated SSIS Migration Harness Generator.
- Generate SSIS Project builds the harness straight from the checked tables (scripts, manifest and metadata seed are produced in memory); the reference project, template package and project name are remembered, so later runs take one click. Each project keeps the scaffolder run it was built from in a Scaffolder subfolder; SSIS Settings... can rebuild from it (or any exported run) without connecting, and can save the project with DontSaveSensitive so no passwords or secrets are stored in it.
- Removed the truncate, teardown and Mermaid diagram outputs and the output checkboxes. Step 3 holds only table list, staging table and GUID table settings; Export saves SQL scripts, the data dictionary or a scaffolder run.
- Generate SSIS Project dialog accepts .sln or .dtproj references and an explicit template package.
- The generated project keeps the reference project's connection managers and follows the scaffolder file groups, with its own project name and a Run_Migration entry point.
- Created record ids are written to the GUID tables from the create destination's output (SavedRecordId).
- Reference destinations may map owner, state and audit columns; a column the update destination leaves out (such as overriddencreatedon) is left out for every table.
- GUID tables hold only the record id and legacy id; staging legacy ids are UNIQUE.
- Staging packages: Create Staging Tables, then one Stage task per table generated from the reference's Stage task and SQL file (lookups resolved through GUID tables). Harness packages start with Create GUID Tables; the setup package also creates all GUID tables. Run_Migration runs staging then harness per group.
- KingswaySoft automation options (bypass flows, disable plugins/workflows/auditing) are carried to every table. Deferred updates re-resolve their lookups from legacy data, including polymorphic ones via their type column.
- The generator runs inside the plugin (C#); nothing else needs to be installed. Reports skipped tables and unresolved issues. Does not execute a migration.
- Tooltips on every control explain what it is for.

1.2026.7.8: Harness metadata output and a guided four-step layout.
- New meta_seed.sql output (off by default): MERGE statements populating meta.Entity and meta.ColumnMap, the metadata an SSIS package generator reads to build a migration harness. Structural facts (tier, table names, SSIS data types, lookup targets) refresh on every run; hand-tuned values (WriteMode, BatchSize, ThreadCount, IsEnabled, IncludeOnCreate, IncludeOnUpdate) are written once and never overwritten. Attributes dropped from Dataverse are removed; entities outside the run are untouched, so scoping to one solution never deletes another's metadata
- Cycle members automatically get a second PassNo = 2 entity row carrying only the lookups deferred to break the cycle - the deferred update pass the warnings have always described in prose
- Tables with no match-key column are seeded with IsEnabled = 0 and reported in the warnings panel, rather than silently producing an entity that cannot decide create versus update
- Reworked layout into four numbered steps: Load Tables and Set Output Folder are now prominent buttons in labeled step groups, filters and outputs sit together in step 3, and Generate Scripts ends the flow
- Quick-start guide rewritten around the four steps

1.2026.7.7: Machine-readable run manifest.
- New manifest.json output (on by default): tables with dependency tier and file assignment, columns with SQL and Dataverse types, lookup targets (and which are in scope), match keys, dropped cycle edges and per-column deferred-update flags - for driving ETL package sequencing and deferred lookup passes

1.2026.7.6: Solution picker improvements.
- Lists managed AND unmanaged solutions, with managed ones labeled "(managed)" - replaces the 1.2026.7.5 toggle
- Solution dropdown widens to fit long solution names

1.2026.7.5: "Include managed" toggle next to the Solution picker (managed solutions labeled; patches always excluded).

1.2026.7.4: Fix update loop - 1.2026.7.3 was packaged with a mismatched assembly version. Do not install 1.2026.7.3.

1.2026.7.3: Feedback round.
- Solution picker now lists only unmanaged solutions and excludes patches
- Generated SQL no longer emits GO separators or ON [PRIMARY]
- Selected output folder is displayed in the toolbar (full path on hover)
- Genericized example text in the dependency exclusions dialog
- Tooltips on every control, quick-start guide in the preview pane, clearer warnings panel

1.2026.7.2: Fix tool list icons (re-encoded PNG metadata images).

1.2026.7.1: Initial release.
- Staging and GUID mapping table DDL from Dataverse metadata (drop-and-recreate or create-if-missing)
- Strict one-dependency-tier-per-file batching for SSIS package sequencing; cycles broken by edge-dropping with deferred-update warnings
- Solution-based table and column filtering; per-environment remembered selections
- Configurable table prefixes and match-key suffixes; dependency-ranking exclusions
- Extra outputs: truncate script, teardown script, styled Excel data dictionary, Mermaid dependency diagram
- Guarded match-key indexes; session metadata cache; cancelable generation
summary: Scaffold SQL staging and GUID mapping tables from Dataverse metadata, batched by dependency tier - plus data dictionary, JSON run manifest, harness metadata seed, and SSIS migration harness generation.
title: Dataverse Migration Scaffolder
